tests.title: Borrowing and returning change the copies on the shelf
A member can have at most 3 books out
Late fees start after the 14-day loan period
A loan can be returned only once
A book with every copy out can't be borrowed
The fee for one loan is at most 200

bugs.why: daysLate counts every day since the book was borrowed, so even an on-time return is charged; the 14-day loan period is never taken off
bugs.fix: daysLate = max(0, days since borrowed - LOAN_DAYS).

edits.fixed: long daysLate = Math.max(0, Dates.daysBetween(borrowedAt, returnedAt) - LoanRules.LOAN_DAYS);

bugs.why: the loan-limit check lets a member take a 4th book (> instead of >=)
bugs.fix: Refuse when the member already has MAX_OPEN_LOANS (3) open loans: open.size() >= LoanRules.MAX_OPEN_LOANS.
